messages:
Sam: Kicking off a small canary rollout: v2 -> v2-quant in us-west1, 5% traffic now.
Priya: Please include an explicit fallback chain in the rollout policy. Prefer: region_failover -> same-model cross-region -> variant_downgrade -> capacity_shed.
Matt: Fine, but we need exact triggers and hysteresis. Suggested triggers: p95_latency > 150ms OR error_rate > 1.5% for 2m windows, require 3 consecutive windows.
Eva: +1. Also ensure cohort isolation for A/B splits: decisions must be scoped to cohort_id.
Sam: Proposal for circuit breaker: lock automated fallbacks for 10m after a trigger, and cap auto-fallbacks to 2 per 10m window across cluster.
Priya: Add a capability check before variant swap: flags = [tool_calls, kv_cache, quant_kernels_available]. If incompatible, skip to next fallback.
Matt: Telemetry: emit decision events with trace_id, reason, cohort_id, prev_state, new_state, and a small shard load snapshot.
Dee: QA: add a simulate endpoint that runs policy against a historical telemetry slice or synthetic spike and returns the decisions without changing live state.
Sam: Console UX: show live fallback chain, active link, lock state, who/what triggered it, and an inline "rollback" + approval flow for cost-sensitive changes.
Priya: Safety guard: if a fallback increases per-token cost by >20% compared to baseline, require manual approval in prod.
Matt: For A/B experiments: fallbacks are per-cohort. If cohort A triggers a downgrade, do not auto-apply to cohort B. Also need cohort cooldowns.
Sam: Rate limiter to avoid thrash: at most one auto-fallback cluster-wide per 60s, and per-cohort cooldown of 120s.
Priya: Action items: I'll write compatibility predicate and capability flags. Matt: design the rollouts API and event schema. Sam: implement presets and canary runner. Eva: console mockups. Dee: QA simulate harness.
deploy-bot: Canary started for rollout 1790500000 at 2026-03-19T09:12:40Z — 5% us-west1 -> v2-quant
ops-bot: Created ticket INF-4021 "rollback/fallback matrix + rollout policy API" assigned to Priya,Matt,Sam,Eva,Dee
Matt: API shape suggestion: GET /rollouts/{id}/policy returns ordered array of fallbacks and circuit metadata. POST /rollouts/{id}/simulate accepts telemetry slice -> decision trace.
Sam: I'll open a WIP PR with a YAML schema and a small state machine that applies the chain. will include unit tests for cohort isolation and simulated spikes.
Priya: Let's include default presets: conservative (long windows, manual confirm), balanced (our default), aggressive (short windows, auto-swap). UI should explain tradeoffs.
Eva: Note: if regional failover routes to a region lacking quant kernels, compatibility check should cause fallback to skip to model_variant or next entry.
Matt: Logging: every decision must include a unique decision_id and tie into distributed trace for end-to-end visibility.
Sam: Great. Closing thread while we work on RFC and PRs. will post links when ready. :thumbsup:
